value set `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicinal-product-domain|5.0.0` as defined in FHIR R5

* `http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicinal-product-domain|5.0.0`

Note that all concepts are included in this cross-version definition because no concepts have compatible representations
